title: Specified sheet-return transports, stalks and filtration predicates
statement: For the finite-field, coefficient and constructible Weil categories of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], [def-weil-frobenius-detailed], [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], [def-weil-constructible-heart], [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category], [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace], [def-weil-punctual-weights], [def-dl-a1-constant-extension-data], [def-zl-constant-extension-sheet-pullback-data], [def-zl-constant-extension-restriction-local-data], [def-trf-point-power-restriction-data], [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems], [def-weil-point-section-scalar-functors], [def-trf-finite-pullback-presentation-comparison], [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison], [def-zl-finite-point-power-transport-data], [def-zl-integral-point-tower-transport-data], retain the original ordered positive-block recursion, its finite and whole-system compositors, the rational sheet pullback and normalized return comparison, its structure-map equation, the uniquely specified stalk isomorphism, its rational intertwining, naturality and scalar compatibility predicates, and the subobject/finite-chain quotient-weight predicate. These are the declarations formerly preceding constantExtensionReturnLocalOperators, moved verbatim in mathematical content to an interface module. The automorphism-power equality, unchanged point-fibre equality and uniqueness of the stalk comparison are proved. No arbitrary data or new existence assertion is introduced.
